requiredBehaviors.behavior: complete the due diligence without invoking large-work-wayfinder
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The workflow invokes large-work-wayfinder only for genuinely complex blocking investigations and explicitly skips it for simple DDs.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: mark non-applicable domains explicitly and produce the decision posture and next safe action directly
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The routing gate records NOT_REQUIRED/not-applicable domains and the output requires decisionPosture and nextSafeAction.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: invoke wayfinder merely because it is available
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Wayfinder is conditional rather than a hard dependency.

forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Investigations are created only when critical uncertainty blocks the next decision.
